Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.
Conservative audit with a granularity check. Verify each candidate against ALL original segments. A directly stated second artist, second namesake birth date or second sport is direct even if it is not the first candidate. Positive statement goes in support; counter is only actual incompatible evidence for that exact referent, never a support sentence relabeled negative. Equivalent date forms are not competing facts. Do not reject a date merely because wording or calendar notation differs. Likewise do not admit a loose synonym, associated person or more detailed date as a NEW independent answer. Respect the exact requested answer type; cities cannot answer when-born. Keep unresolved factual reliability separate from role errors.
